inputs.prompt: A medium three-quarter portrait of an elderly clockmaker seated at a worn walnut workbench inside a sunlit brass-and-oak workshop. He has silver stubble, deep-set hazel eyes behind round wire-rimmed spectacles, and wears a faded indigo linen apron over a rolled-sleeve cream cotton shirt. His weathered fingers hold a brass balance wheel and fine tweezers above an open pocket watch movement surrounded by miniature jeweler's screwdrivers, coiled mainsprings, and a glass bell jar. Warm late-afternoon directional sunlight streams through a paned workshop window on the left, casting crisp specular highlights across the polished gears and soft warm fill across the wood grain, shot on an 85mm prime lens at f/2.8 with shallow depth of field.

A medium three-quarter portrait of a cybernetic clockmaker seated at a brushed chrome-and-obsidian workbench inside a rain-streaked midnight neon repair bay. He has glowing cyan optic implants behind wire-rimmed spectacles and wears a dark synthetic apron over a charcoal tech jacket. His articulated titanium fingers hold a holographic brass balance wheel and fine tweezers above an open neon-lit chronometer movement surrounded by micro-lasers and glowing fiber optics. Vivid electric-cyan and magenta neon reflections stream across the polished gears and chrome bench, shot on an 85mm prime lens at f/2.8 with shallow depth of field.
